card.name: Kumina
card.profile: Afro-Jamaican Kongo-derived religion, dance and drumming complex, developed mid–late 19th c. among Central African indentured laborers after Emancipation; counterclockwise circle dance around drummers can induce possession (myal). NOT UNESCO (only Moore Town Maroon heritage 00053). Sacred = ethnographic record.
